Le Haut-commissariat à la numérisation (: The High Commission for Digitization (HCN) announced on Thursday, July 9, 2026, the deployment of the "Apostille" electronic platform. This online service eliminates the requirement for the physical legalization of foreign public documents, thereby simplifying administrative procedures. Accessible via the electronic portal for digital services, this solution is part of the national strategy to modernize public services.
Conçue et développée par le HCN, la plat: Designed and developed by the HCN, the platform meets the needs of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the National Community Abroad, and African Affairs. This ministry will be responsible for managing and providing the service, in collaboration with several partner sectors. The first phase notably involves the Ministries of Interior, Local Authorities and Transport, Justice, Finance, Higher Education and Scientific Research, as well as National Education, Vocational Training, Post and Telecommunications, and the services of the Bank of Algeria.
